newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack denies London Underground report.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack denies London Underground report.

text.p: Railtrack Plc, the rail infrastructure group privatised last May, denied on Tuesday it was intereted in mounting a takeover bid for the London Underground network if it is sold off by the Government.

The denial follows a report in The Times newspaper on Tuesday which depressed Railtrack's share price by 12 pence to 269. But a spokesman for Railtrack told Reuters "This is pure speculation. Railtrack has no plans to acquire London Underground infrastructure. Railtrack already has a huge task of heavy investment in its own infrastructure." This amounts to one billion pounds per annum over 10 years, he said.
The Times report said that Railtrack had told government ministers only a company of its size could afford the one million stg investment needed to upgrade the underground system.
Railtrack, which owns the track, signalling and stations of the nationwide rail system, saw its shares more than double in the year since flotation, hitting 429 pence per share on January 16.
